import os
import pathlib
import sys
import tempfile

root = pathlib.Path('.')
incoming = root / 'incoming'
normalized = root / 'normalized'
normalized.mkdir(mode=0o755, exist_ok=True)
errors = []
with (root / 'encodings.tsv').open('r', encoding='utf-8', newline='') as manifest:
    header = manifest.readline().rstrip('\r\n').split('\t')
    if header != ['file', 'encoding']:
        raise SystemExit('invalid manifest header')
    for line_number, raw in enumerate(manifest, 2):
        row = raw.rstrip('\r\n')
        if not row:
            continue
        parts = row.split('\t')
        if len(parts) != 2:
            errors.append(f'encodings.tsv:{line_number}: malformed row')
            continue
        name, encoding = parts
        if pathlib.PurePath(name).name != name or name in ('.', '..'):
            errors.append(f'encodings.tsv:{line_number}: unsafe filename {name!r}')
            continue
        src = incoming / name
        dst = normalized / name
        tmp_name = None
        try:
            source_bytes = src.read_bytes()
            text = source_bytes.decode(encoding, errors='strict')
            text = text.replace('\r\n', '\n').replace('\r', '\n')
            output_bytes = text.encode('utf-8', errors='strict')
            with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(dir=normalized, prefix=f'.{name}.', delete=False) as tmp:
                tmp_name = tmp.name
                tmp.write(output_bytes)
                tmp.flush()
                os.fsync(tmp.fileno())
            os.chmod(tmp_name, src.stat().st_mode & 0o777)
            os.replace(tmp_name, dst)
            tmp_name = None
            print(f'PUBLISHED\t{name}\t{encoding}\t{len(source_bytes)} input bytes\t{len(output_bytes)} output bytes')
        except (LookupError, UnicodeError, OSError) as exc:
            if tmp_name is not None:
                try:
                    os.unlink(tmp_name)
                except FileNotFoundError:
                    pass
            errors.append(f'{name}: {encoding}: {exc}')
for error in errors:
    print(f'UNDECODABLE\t{error}', file=sys.stderr)
if errors:
    sys.exit(2)

import hashlib
import pathlib

root = pathlib.Path('.')
rows = [line.split() for line in (root / 'encodings.tsv').read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines()[1:] if line.strip()]
failures = []
for name, encoding in rows:
    src = (root / 'incoming' / name).read_bytes()
    print(f'SOURCE {name}: size={len(src)} sha256={hashlib.sha256(src).hexdigest()}')
    try:
        decoded = src.decode(encoding, errors='strict')
    except UnicodeDecodeError as exc:
        exists = (root / 'normalized' / name).exists()
        print(f'EXPECTED_DECODE_ERROR {name}: byte={exc.start} reason={exc.reason}; output_exists={exists}')
        if exists:
            failures.append(f'{name} must not be published')
        continue
    expected = decoded.replace('\r\n', '\n').replace('\r', '\n').encode('utf-8')
    dst = root / 'normalized' / name
    if not dst.is_file():
        failures.append(f'{name} missing')
        continue
    actual = dst.read_bytes()
    try:
        actual_text = actual.decode('utf-8', errors='strict')
        utf8 = True
    except UnicodeDecodeError:
        actual_text = ''
        utf8 = False
    cr_count = actual.count(b'\r')
    records = actual.count(b'\n') + (0 if actual.endswith(b'\n') else 1)
    print(f'OUTPUT {name}: exact_expected={actual == expected} utf8={utf8} cr_bytes={cr_count} records={records} final_newline={actual.endswith(bytes([10]))} sha256={hashlib.sha256(actual).hexdigest()} text={actual_text!r}')
    if actual != expected or not utf8 or cr_count:
        failures.append(f'{name} failed content validation')
partials = sorted(p.name for p in (root / 'normalized').iterdir() if p.name.startswith('.'))
print(f'PARTIAL_TEMP_FILES {partials}')
if partials:
    failures.append('temporary files remain')
if failures:
    for failure in failures:
        print(f'FAIL {failure}')
    raise SystemExit(1)
print('VALIDATION PASS')

root = pathlib.Path('.')

    expected = decoded.replace('\r\n', '\n').replace('\r', '\n').encode('utf-8')
    dst = root / 'normalized' / name
